thread: jordan-cust: Hey team — running the collector on our Private deployment to generate a debug bundle but the upload step fails with a 403. Collector output: `Upload failed: HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden (x-request-id=abcd-1234)` maria-support: Sorry about that — can you paste the full collector command and the exact x-request-id? jordan-cust: Command: `./redwood-collector --config /etc/redwood/collector.yml --output /tmp/debug-bundle.tar.gz --upload auto` Request id from logs: `abcd-1234` and also `abcd-1235` for the retry. Logs: ```2026-02-12T14:02:11Z INFO upload start to s3://support-uploads/xyz.tar.gz 2026-02-12T14:02:12Z ERROR upload failed status=403 x-request-id=abcd-1234 body=""``` maria-support: Got it. Two quick possibilities: (1) presigned upload signed by the control plane expired or was rejected by your S3 policy, (2) an internal firewall/NAT is rewriting headers. Are you on an air-gapped/VPC install? jordan-cust: VPC install, customer-managed KMS. There is a strict S3 policy and corporate proxy. devin-se: @maria-support please loop me in — sounds like the presigned PUT to the support S3 is being rejected by the proxy or by the bucket policy because of incorrect x-amz-acl or missing x-amz-server-side-encryption headers (KMS). maria-support: @devin-se can you verify whether the collector attaches SSE headers for KMS? If not, we'll need a fallback. devin-se: Collector should include `x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms` and `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id`. But for Private installs with customer KMS we avoid sending key IDs. The support presigned URL assumes default SSE is allowed; if your bucket policy requires explicit key id, that would 403. jordan-cust: We do require explicit key id. How do we proceed? I can't change bucket policy easily. beni-ops: Two options: (A) generate bundle locally and scp to our support gateway (we'll give you an ephemeral scp endpoint), or (B) run the collector with `--upload off` and then we provide an internal support tunnel command `supportctl tunnel --dest support-uploader` that will accept an HTTP PUT from inside your VPC. Which is easier? jordan-cust: scp endpoint sounds easiest for security team. How do we create the bundle and scrub secrets before sending? collector-bot: Tip: run `./redwood-collector --collect --output /tmp/redwood-bundle-$(date +%s).tar.gz --redact yes` to apply default redaction rules. See /opt/redwood/collector/redact.conf for patterns. maria-support: Recommended workflow: 1) Run collector locally with `--upload off` and `--redact yes`. 2) Verify size `du -h /tmp/redwood-bundle-*.tar.gz`. 3) Run the redaction audit `tar -tzf /tmp/redwood-bundle-*.tar.gz | grep -E "(private_key|keystore|.pem|.jks)" || echo OK`. 4) If nothing sensitive shows up, use scp to the support endpoint we'll provide. jordan-cust: Ran collector: `./redwood-collector --collect --output /tmp/debug-167.tar.gz --upload off --redact yes` produced `/tmp/debug-167.tar.gz` 85MB. Audit returned `OK`. maria-support: Great. I'll create an ephemeral scp user and endpoint and DM you creds. Note: for KMS we also need the request IDs from the failing attempts + the collector log with `--verbosity debug`. Could you attach snippet `grep -A3 "x-request-id=abcd-1234" /var/log/redwood/collector.log`? jordan-cust: Pasted: ``` 2026-02-12T14:02:09Z DEBUG sigv4: canonical-request: ... 2026-02-12T14:02:11Z DEBUG http: PUT https://support-uploads.s3.internal/xyz.tar.gz 2026-02-12T14:02:11Z DEBUG headers: {Authorization: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=..., x-amz-date=..., x-amz-server-side-encryption=aws:kms} 2026-02-12T14:02:12Z ERROR upload failed status=403 x-request-id=abcd-1234 response-body="AccessDenied" ``` beni-ops: That confirms the presigned flow sent SSE header but the bucket rejected based on key id requirement. We'll accept scp. Maria — can you create the endpoint and SFTP user? maria-support: Creating now, will DM creds in 2m. Also @oncall-ryan FYI in case we need support tunnel. oncall-ryan: Pinged infra team to open temporary support tunnel if scp fails. jordan-cust: Got the creds via DM, uploading now: `scp /tmp/debug-167.tar.gz support-uploader@34.82.200.12:/incoming/` jordan-cust: Upload complete. MD5: `f9b8c3e2d7a4b6c08e0a2f4b1a2f6d7c` maria-support: Received bundle and started intake. We'll run automated redaction checks and decrypt only metadata needed for analysis. We'll follow up if we need more logs or reproduction steps. Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup: devin-se: For long term: we'll add an option to the collector to request presigned URLs with explicit KMS key id header negotiation for Private installs. Filed internal ticket INF-8921. jordan-cust: Appreciate it — please share any follow-ups. maria-support: Closing loop here once analysis complete, leaving thread open for additional repro steps
